c.title: $4,200 / 2br - 1100ft2 - Furnished Yaletown Condo, 2 Bed, 2 Bath, 1,100 Sq Ft, $4,200 All-In
c.description:
Move in November 8 with nothing but a suitcase. This fully furnished two-bedroom, two-bathroom condo is in the heart of Yaletown, a short walk from David Lam Park and the seawall. Rent is $4,200 a month and covers utilities and high-speed internet, with nothing added on top.

1,100 sq ft with in-suite laundry and a private balcony 21 floors up, with the views that come with the height. Furnished throughout, so there’s nothing to buy or move in.

Building amenities include a fitness centre, pool, hot tub, and sauna. Groceries, dining, and the Canada Line are steps away.

Terms:

Available November 8 through mid January (flexible)
No pets, no smoking
Security deposit required
Quick pre-screening, then viewing by appointment

Reply here or call the number below to book a look.

Moe Entezar, REALTOR®, Property Manager
REMAX Masters Realty
